scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
other_conditions: The applicant company or its group must have an existing presence in India or globally in the automotive vehicle and components manufacturing business (for existing OEM/Component applicants).
For OEM applicants the revenue from automotive and/or auto‑component manufacturing must be at least ₹10,000 crore; for component applicants at least ₹500 crore.
The fixed‑asset (gross block) investment must be at least ₹3,000 crore for OEMs and ₹150 crore for component firms.
Group companies are defined as two or more enterprises that jointly hold ≥26 % voting rights or can appoint ≥50 % of the other enterprise’s board members.

New non‑automotive investor companies (not currently in automobile or component manufacturing) must have a global net worth of at least ₹1,000 crore as per audited statements for the year ending 31 Mar 2021.
They must commit to cumulative new domestic investment in India as per the schedule (e.g., ₹300 crore for Champion OEMs by 31 Mar 2023, increasing to ₹2,000 crore by 31 Mar 2027, etc.).
Applicants must submit a clear business plan to invest in India and generate revenues from advanced automotive‑technology vehicles or components.
The applicant must meet the percentage year‑on‑year growth criteria from the initial threshold.
All new investments must be made by the same legal entity that applies for the incentive.
The company must satisfy the cumulative investment condition each year; failure to do so results in no incentive for that year, though eligibility may continue in subsequent years.
Preference will be given to companies that front‑load their investment, which will be evaluated using Net Present Value (NPV) calculations with the bank rate as the discount factor.
benefits_summary: Incentives of 8%–16% of determined sales value are provided, with additional percentages for cumulative sales targets and extra benefits for battery‑electric and hydrogen‑fuel‑cell vehicles/components.
documents_required: Proof of payment of the non‑refundable application fee
